explanation.headline: Enoxaparin sodium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Sanofi-Aventis U.S. LLC posted a discontinuation on 2026-10-20

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows enoxaparin sodium is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Sanofi-Aventis U.S. LLC posted a discontinuation of enoxaparin sodium injection for the U.S. market on 2026-10-20, stating the decision is not related to product safety or quality concerns.
Corvale East holds 87 syringes of the 60 mg/0.6 mL presentation with 10.9 days on hand at 8 per day, and 246 syringes of the 100 mg/mL 0.8 mL presentation with 24.5 days on hand at 10 per day.
Corvale General holds 152 syringes of the 100 mg/mL 0.8 mL presentation with 14.5 days on hand at 10.5 per day.

A label for enoxaparin sodium names Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (FEI 3010625707) as a registered plant for analysis, manufacture, and pack, last inspected with a VAI classification on 2023-11-10.
FDA inspection records for that plant show VAI classifications on 2015-05-12, 2018-04-03, and 2023-11-10.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
